batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit, academic session 2018-2019, Set-A — transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU question bank), book PDF pp.253-259 (printed pp.68-74 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); the two forms never co-occur for the same question in this paper, so no tag-vs-solution disagreement arises. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.253) carries 60 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.258, continuing on p.259) carries 19 (Q23, 25, 26, 28, 29, 30, 31, 33, 38, 39, 40, 56, 59, 62, 63, 71, 72, 74, 79); each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. CRITICAL COMPLETENESS FINDING: the two tiers together carry only 79 distinct printed numbers, NOT 80 — printed question number 44 is entirely absent from the book: on book PDF p.255 (printed p.70) the Short Syllabus run passes directly from Q43 to Q45, and no Q44 appears in the Extra Syllabus block or anywhere else on pp.253-259 (verified by full visual re-read of every page and by an OCR finding-aid scan). No Q44 has been invented; this pack therefore contains the 79 questions the book actually prints, and the missing Q44 (which by number range and content would fall in Higher Mathematics) is documented here and in the ANSWERS file. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-5 (5), English Q6-20 (15), Higher Mathematics Q21-60 (40 printed numbers, 39 present because Q44 is missing), Physics Q61-80 (20) — exactly the expected H Unit composition apart from the missing Q44. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.253 carries Q1-15; p.254 carries Q16-22, 24, 27, 32, 34; p.255 carries Q35-37, 41-43, 45, 46; p.256 carries Q47-55, 57; p.257 carries Q58, 60, 61, 64-70, 73, 75; p.258 carries Q76-78, 80 and (Extra Syllabus) Q23, 25, 26, 28-31; p.259 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q33, 38-40, 56, 59, 62, 63, 71, 72, 74, 79. Keys: 76 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly THREE printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q29 (Extra Syllabus, 'সমাধান: (No Answer)'), Q32 ('সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)') and Q57 ('সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'); those three carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Preserved print anomalies: Q44 is missing from the book entirely (see above); Q59 options (a) and (d) both print 13/2 identically; Q32's stem asks for a vertex coordinate but all four options print single fractions; Q20's option (d) prints 'a,b,c all are correct' although the printed key is the single tag [Ans: b]; Q16 options (a)-(c) print the misspellings 'persever', 'subsiquent', 'tolerent' and its printed solution glosses 'tolerant' as 'tourant'; Q78(c) prints '0.09_8' with the impossible octal digit 9; Q35(d) prints a negative length (-2√2); Q29's stem prints '১ম' before 'n সংখ্যক'; Q48's stem prints its fraction with no spaces ('cotAcotB-1' over 'cotA+cotB'); Q66's stem prints '40ms^-1' with no space against Q65's '40 ms^-1'; Q67's stem prints '5kg' with no space; Q8(d) prints 'adjustable' with a lower-case initial. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram; diagrams appear only inside the printed worked solutions of Q34 (right triangle ABC) and Q35 (axis-intercept line diagram). BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.252 (printed p.67) belongs to the PREVIOUS paper (H Unit 2019-2020 Set-E) and book PDF p.260 (printed p.75) opens the NEXT paper (H Unit 2017-2018 Set-6) — neither is part of this paper and nothing from them is included here. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 44 of 79 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 2: key conflict - Satt key (d) recorded, answer unverified row 4: excluded (DIFFER) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 22: excluded (DIFFER) row 29: no-correct-option disposition corroborated row 30: excluded (DIFFER) row 32: excluded (DIFFER) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 47: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 52: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 53: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 55: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 56: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 57: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 58: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 60: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 61: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 71: excluded (DIFFER) row 72: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 75: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 79: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০১৮-১৯') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-A of JU H Unit 2018-2019 occupies printed pp.68-74 = book PDF pp.253-259: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.253-258 (banner on p.253) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.73 (book PDF p.258) and continuing on printed p.74 (book PDF p.259). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.253) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৮-২০১৯ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-A, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The previous paper (H Unit 2019-2020 Set-E) ends on printed p.67 (book PDF p.252) and the following paper (H Unit 2017-2018 Set-6) begins on printed p.75 (book PDF p.260). IMPORTANT: printed question number 44 is not printed anywhere in this paper — the book passes directly from Q43 to Q45 on printed p.70 (book PDF p.255) — so this transcription contains the 79 questions actually printed and invents none. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image (300-dpi renders), with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops) of the Bangla block on p.253, the Q41-Q46 block on p.255, and all remaining pages in half-page crops. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, vectors with î/ĵ/k̂ unit vectors; nuclear/atomic notation with left plain subscripts/superscripts, e.g. _86A^222; set/base subscripts as _8, _10).
